original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非警方调查连环杀害女性案 约翰内斯堡附近发现第十具女性遗体
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非警方在约翰内斯堡以东的埃库鲁莱尼地区又发现一具女性遗体，使近几个月当地发现的女性死者人数升至10人。警方表示尚不能排除存在连环杀手的可能，并指出多起案件在受害者特征和作案手法上存在相似之处。事件引发全国对性别暴力规模的强烈抗议。

location.raw_text: Ekurhuleni, to the east of Johannesburg; Tembisa neighbourhood north-east of central Johannesburg

key_facts.fact: 南非警方在约翰内斯堡以东的埃库鲁莱尼地区发现又一具女性遗体，当地近几个月发现的女性死者增至10人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police in South Africa say they have discovered another body in Ekurhuleni, to the east of Johannesburg, bringing the number of women found dead there in recent months to 10.

key_facts.fact: 遗体于周六上午在坦比萨一处墓地被发现，由前一晚同在一家酒吧的朋友辨认
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The latest body was discovered at a cemetery in the Tembisa neighbourhood north-east of central Johannesburg.

key_facts.fact: 当地警察局长称不能排除存在连环杀手的可能，并指出10起死亡案件存在相似之处
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The local police commissioner said his force could not rule out the possibility that there was a serial killer on the loose, noting similarities across the 10 deaths in Ekurhuleni, as well as another in Soweto.

key_facts.fact: 警方称现阶段尚不能确定最新死亡是否与其他案件有关联
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gauteng Police Commissioner Tommy Mthombeni said that, at this early stage in the investigation, it was too soon to say whether the woman's death was linked to the others.

key_facts.fact: 南非人权委员会称今年4月至6月有569名女性被杀、1052人遭遇谋杀未遂
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the South African Human Rights Commission said last week that 569 women were killed and 1,052 others survived attempted murder between April and June this year.

uncertainties: 是否存在连环杀手尚未证实，警方称不能排除但无法得出确定结论
最新死亡是否与其他案件存在关联尚待调查确认
遇害者身份尚未公开确认
目前仅一个来源（BBC News）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
